text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
For the Tenno Sho (Autumn), the rival 
Duramente is keeping her eyes on is Satono 
Crown.

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
No matter the dire straits, she always 
looks for a path to victory. Duramente 
respected Satono Crown for only growing 
stronger in the face of adversity.

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
Satono Crown also smiled fearlessly, 
stating she would surpass Duramente. 
Sparks flew from their mutual seriousness.
